7.2. Construction
The project construction will take place according to the construction schedule established in the
Generator Interconnection Agreement. In the event, a project goes into suspension the required
Network Upgrades and TO Interconnection Facilities will be constructed on the schedule
described in the appendices to the GIA, except for the following reasons:
i. Construction is stopped by a Governmental Authority. ii. Network Upgrades are not
needed for another project; or
iii. MISO or the TO determines that a Force Majeure event prevents construction.


The IC will closely coordinate the various construction activities with the Transmission Owner to
make sure the appropriate design standards are followed and technical specifications of the IC
constructed facilities match with that of the TO constructed facilities. IC construction activities are
expected to be conducted in parallel with TO construction activities.
